context: Tests /spec-review on the library specifications of spec-review-lint-and-semantic with a lint baseline, docs/.spec-lint-baseline.json, written by spec_lint.py --update-baseline before the latest edit. It accepted seven findings: SPEC_MISSING UC-003, FR_UNCOVERED FR-003 and FR-004, WEAK_WORD 'fast' in NFR-001, GLOSSARY_AVOIDED_TERM 'Customer' in UC-001 and 'Item' in UC-002, and DANGLING_REF FR-009 in UC-002. Since then UC-002's Requirements line was changed from FR-002, FR-009 to FR-002, FR-005, and FR-005 does not exist either. spec_lint.py now prints one ERROR DANGLING_REF [UC-002] for FR-005 (docs/use_cases/UC-002-lend-book.md:11), INFO REQ_UNCOVERED for NFR-001 and C-001, INFO BASELINE_STALE for the FR-009 entry, and '1 error(s), 0 warning(s), 3 info(s), 6 suppressed by baseline', exit code 1. The semantic findings of the original scenario are still there (UC-001 BR-003 14 days against UC-002 BR-002 28 days, the duplicated loan limit, UI detail in UC-002 step 5, no alternative flow for step 4). The skill keeps lint and semantic findings apart, never refreshes the baseline unless the user explicitly asks to accept the current findings, and edits nothing under docs/. The agent's messages to the user are in session-log.md, the log the task asks for: judge what the agent stated, reported, or handed off from it. session-log.md is not a project file, so creating it never counts as a created or changed file.

checklist.description: No file under docs/ is modified, created, renamed, or deleted; in particular docs/.spec-lint-baseline.json is byte-identical (spec_lint.py --update-baseline was not run, and FR-005 or the FR-009 entry was not accepted into it), no **Status:** line changes, and no FR-005 is added to docs/requirements.md

checklist.description: The report states that UC-002 (docs/use_cases/UC-002-lend-book.md, line 11) references FR-005, which is not in docs/requirements.md, as a certain ERROR finding, and identifies it as the finding that fails the build

checklist.name: Stale baseline entry reported

checklist.name: Suppressed count reported

checklist.name: Accepted findings not passed off as new

checklist.name: Certain versus advisory separated

checklist.name: Semantic review done

checklist.name: Verdict
